ex.en: Sami has many followers on Twitter.
ex.zh: 薩米在推特上有很多追蹤者。

ex.en: The singer has over a million followers on Instagram.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在 IG 上有超過一百萬名追蹤者。

ex.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
ex.zh: 盧梭很瘋狂，卻有影響力；休謨很理智，卻沒有追隨者。

ex.en: The religion has millions of followers.
ex.zh: 這個宗教有數百萬名信徒。

ex.en: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
ex.zh: 褐煤是一種化石燃料。

ex.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
ex.zh: 由於一些工廠使用化石燃料，化學物質的排放已經造成嚴重的環境問題。

ex.en: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
ex.zh: 她臉上的笑容，代表她已經原諒我了。

ex.en: She forgave the boy for his rudeness.
ex.zh: 她原諒了男孩的粗魯。

ex.en: If he told me the truth, I would have forgiven him.
ex.zh: 如果他跟我說實話，我早就原諒他了。

ex.en: It was so foggy I couldn't tell who it was.
ex.zh: 霧太大了，我看不清楚是誰。

ex.en: It's foggy here in Boston.
ex.zh: 波士頓這裡霧很大。

ex.en: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
ex.zh: 她緩緩消失在霧氣瀰漫的森林中。

ex.en: My memory of that night is a bit foggy.
ex.zh: 我對那晚的記憶有點模糊。

ex.en: I feel foggy in the morning before coffee.
ex.zh: 早上沒喝咖啡前我腦袋都昏昏沉沉的。

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報說明天會是好天氣。

ex.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雪。

ex.en: I heard the weather forecast said it'll rain tonight.
ex.zh: 我聽天氣預報說今晚會下雨。

ex.en: The news forecasts fine weather, but it seems like it is going to rain.
ex.zh: 新聞預報是好天氣，但看起來好像要下雨了。

ex.en: Experts forecast slower economic growth next year.
ex.zh: 專家預測明年經濟成長會放緩。

ex.en: Can you tell me how to fill in this form?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我這份表格怎麼填嗎？

ex.en: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
ex.zh: 請填寫這份表格並在下方簽名。

ex.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
ex.zh: 水和冰雖然形態不同，但其實是同一種物質。

ex.en: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
ex.zh: 這裡用的文法形式是現在進行式。

ex.en: A long queue had formed in front of the shop.
ex.zh: 店門前排起了長長的人龍。

ex.en: He formed a habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他養成了熬夜的習慣。

ex.en: I'll follow up with the client next week.
ex.zh: 我下週會再跟客戶聯絡追蹤。

ex.en: Please follow up on the issues we discussed today.
ex.zh: 請針對今天討論的問題後續追蹤。

ex.en: Could you forward me the email from the client?
ex.zh: 可以把客戶寄來的那封信轉寄給我嗎？

ex.en: I forwarded your message to the sales team.
ex.zh: 我已經把你的訊息轉給業務團隊了。

ex.en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
ex.zh: 他們一直往前走，而我總是在往後退。

ex.en: She stepped forward to ask a question.
ex.zh: 她往前走一步提出問題。

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
ex.zh: 希望早日再見到你。

ex.en: I am looking forward to seeing you next Sunday.
ex.zh: 我期待下週日能見到你。
